code: library(dMod2) dir.create("build", showWarnings = FALSE) # generated sources and shared objects in build/, reused when nothing changed options(dMod2.outdir = "build") cores <- max(1L, min(20L, parallel::detectCores() - 2L)) nstart <- 100L  # fits are saved in results/cache.rds under a key and read from there when present; delete the # file to fit everything again cached <- function(key, expr) {   file <- "results/cache.rds"   dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)   store <- if (file.exists(file)) readRDS(file) else list()   if (is.null(store[[key]])) {     store[[key]] <- expr     saveRDS(store, file)   }   store[[key]] } # a fit of em() cached without the model, which an evaluation at the fit estimates restores cachedEm <- function(key, obj, random, start, control = list(), ...) {   model <- c("design", "prdfn", "errfn", "data")   f <- cached(key, { f <- em(obj, random, start, control = control, ...); f[model] <- NULL; f })   f[model] <- em(obj, random, f$argument, control = modifyList(control, list(trustControl = list(iterlim = 0))),                  verbose = FALSE)[model]   f }  dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse")

title: Target-mediated drug disposition
text: Five dose groups 9 subjects, samples one hour eight weeks; clearance, central volume target level vary subjects 20% CV, readings 15% log scale. seed gives typical draw: share censored readings median seeds 1 50. free drug log10 coordinates, C = 10^C_l10: stays positive binding takes far absolute tolerance solver, log(C) linear state.
code: truth <- log(c(CL = 0.3, V = 3, Q = 0.2, Vp = 3, kon = 5, koff = 0.25, kint = 15, kdeg = 15, R0 = 0.1)) omega <- sqrt(log(1 + 0.2^2)) sigma <- sqrt(log(1 + 0.15^2)) doses <- c(10, 30, 100, 300, 1000) times <- c(1 / 24, 1, 3, 7, 14, 21, 35, 56) lloq <- 0.1 subjects <- sprintf("S%02d", 1:45) table <- data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = rep(doses, each = 9), row.names = subjects) ode <- log10Transform(as.eqnvec(net), states = "C") ode #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1 C_l10 <- (-CL/V-Q/V-R*kon+Cp*Q/((10^(C_l10))*V)+RC*koff/(10^(C_l10)))/log(10) #>   2    Cp <- 1*(Q*(10^(C_l10)))*(1/Vp)-1*(Q*Cp)*(1/Vp) #>   3     R <- -1*(kon*(10^(C_l10))*R)+1*(koff*RC)+1*(ksyn)-1*(kdeg*R) #>   4    RC <- 1*(kon*(10^(C_l10))*R)-1*(koff*RC)-1*(kint*RC) # solver tolerances 1e-10: at the defaults the solver error moves -2 log L by about 1e-4, more than # FOCEI resolves, and the fit stalls short of the optimum x <- Xs(odemodel(ode, modelname = "tmdd", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm),         options = list(atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-10)) g <- Y(c(lcp = "log(10) * C_l10"), x, modelname = "tmdd_g", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) e <- Y(c(lcp = "sigma"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "tmdd_e", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("CL", "V", "Q", "Vp", "kon", "koff", "kint", "ksyn", "kdeg",                                              "C_l10", "Cp", "R", "RC", "sigma")), table = table) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- y", x = c("C_l10", "Cp", "RC"), y = c("log10(dose / V)", "0", "0")) trafo <- insert(trafo, paste("R <-", steady[["R"]])) trafo <- insert(trafo, "ksyn <- kdeg * R0") trafo <- insert(trafo, "dose <- d", d = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c(parameters, "sigma")) trafo <- insert(trafo, CL + V + R0 ~ 1 + (1 | ID)) p <- P(trafo, method = "explicit", modelname = "tmdd_p", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) compile(x, g, e, p, output = "tmdd_all") random <- randomEffects(p)  simulateData <- function(seed) {   set.seed(seed)   eta <- matrix(rnorm(45 * 3, 0, omega), 45, dimnames = list(subjects, c("CL", "V", "R0")))   pars <- c(truth, sigma = log(sigma),             setNames(as.vector(eta), paste0("eta_", rep(colnames(eta), each = 45), "_", subjects)))   pred <- (g * x * p)(times = times, pars = pars, deriv = FALSE)   do.call(rbind, lapply(subjects, function(s) {     v <- pred[[s]][match(times, pred[[s]][, "time"]), "lcp"] + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma)     data.frame(name = "lcp", time = times, value = pmax(v, log(lloq)), sigma = NA_real_, lloq = log(lloq),                condition = s, ID = s, dose = table[s, "dose"])   })) } censored <- vapply(1:50, function(s) mean(simulateData(s)$value <= log(lloq)), 0) seed <- which.min(abs(censored - stats::median(censored))) c(seed = seed, censored = censored[seed], median = stats::median(censored)) #>       seed   censored     median  #> 10.0000000  0.2222222  0.2222222 sim <- simulateData(seed) data <- as.datalist(sim, splitBy = "condition", keepCovariates = c("ID", "dose")) plotData(data) + ggplot2::aes(color = factor(dose)) +   ggplot2::labs(x = "time [days]", y = "ln free drug [nmol/L]", color = "dose [nmol]")

rbind(init, t(vapply(seq_len(nstart - 1L), function(i) init + rnorm(length(init), 0, 0.5), init))) runs <- cached("dMod2", do.call(rbind, unlist(lapply(c(focei = "focei", quadrature = "quadrature"), function(method)   parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(starts)), function(i) {     options(dMod2.cores = 1L)     t <- system.time(f <- tryCatch(em(obj, random, starts[i, ], method = method, control = ctrl, verbose = FALSE),                                    error = function(e) NULL))[["elapsed"]]     data.frame(method = method, start = i, value = if (is.null(f)) NA_real_ else f$value, title: Bile acid transport
code: # Multistart ---- # distributedComputing() saves the objects named in `input`, copies them with the # code and the shared objects of the model to a job folder in the working # directory and runs the code there in the background, as one task on the local # machine. In the task, `cores` holds the cores of `on`, and mstrust() runs ten # fits per core; on Windows the commands run in the sh of Rtools. # ?distributedComputing shows how to send the same code to # other machines with sshNodes() or to a SLURM cluster with slurmCluster(). job <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, pouter, sd = 4, fits = 10 * cores, cores = cores),   on = localNode(.cores), jobname = "ba_fits", input = c("obj", "pouter") ) job  # wait() reports the tasks done, running or failed until none runs. get() joins # the parlists of the tasks; purge() deletes the job folders. job$wait(interval = 5) fits <- as.parframe(job$get()) job$purge(local = TRUE) plotValues(fits)

title: Bile acid transport
text: profiles S, TCA_CELL TCA_CANA flat data. steady-state start canaliculi fixed scale remove direction:
code: # Steady state ---- # The canaliculi start in balance with the cells, at the reflux of closed # junctions, since they open only at time 0. The scale is fixed to 1, which # removes the direction. trafo <- eqnvec() |>   define("x <- x", x = innerpars) |>   define("TCA_buffer <- 0") |>   define("TCA_cana <- TCA_cell*k_export_cana/k_reflux") |>   insert("x <- 10^y", x = .currentSymbols, y = toupper(.currentSymbols)) |>   branch(conditions = c("closed", "open")) |>   define("k_reflux <- 10^K_REFLUX_OPEN", conditionMatch = "open") |>   insert("S <- 0") p <- P(trafo, modelname = "ba_trafo_ss", compile = TRUE)  outerpars <- getParameters(p) pouter    <- structure(rep(-1, length(outerpars)), names = outerpars) obj  <- normL2(data, g*x*p, attrName = "data") +   constraintL2(pouter, sigma = 20, attrName = "prior")  # `wait = TRUE` waits for the tasks, returns their results and deletes the job. fits <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, pouter, sd = 4, fits = 10 * cores, cores = cores),   on = localNode(.cores), jobname = "ba_fits_ss", input = c("obj", "pouter"),   wait = TRUE ) plotValues(fits) bestfit <- as.parvec(fits)  profiles <- profile(obj, bestfit, whichPar = names(bestfit), method = "integrate",                     cores = .cores, limits = c(lower = -5, upper = 5),                     stepControl = list(stop = "data"),                     algoControl = list(reoptimize = TRUE)) plotProfile(profiles, mode %in% c("data", "prior")) # Fixed reflux ---- # K_REFLUX_OPEN stays practically non-identifiable: the profile is open towards # instantaneous reflux, so the reflux of open junctions is fixed to a fast rate. # K_EXPORT_SINUS stays open towards slow export below the 68% level. trafo <- eqnvec() |>   define("x <- x", x = innerpars) |>   define("TCA_buffer <- 0") |>   define("TCA_cana <- TCA_cell*k_export_cana/k_reflux") |>   insert("x <- 10^y", x = .currentSymbols, y = toupper(.currentSymbols)) |>   branch(conditions = c("closed", "open")) |>   define("k_reflux <- 10^6", conditionMatch = "open") |>   insert("S <- 0") p <- P(trafo, modelname = "ba_trafo_final", compile = TRUE)  obj     <- normL2(data, g*x*p, attrName = "data") bestfit <- trust(obj, bestfit[getParameters(p)], rinit = 1)$argument #+ fig.height = 3.5 plot((g*x*p)(times, bestfit, deriv = FALSE), data) + labs(color = "junctions")  # the parameters with their 95% confidence intervals, on log10 profiles <- profile(obj, bestfit, whichPar = names(bestfit), method = "integrate",                     cores = .cores, limits = c(lower = -5, upper = 5),                     algoControl = list(reoptimize = TRUE)) confint(profiles, level = 0.95)

title: Bile acid transport
code: # Prediction profile ---- # The cellular bile acid at time t becomes a parameter v, tied to the model by a # data point with a small sigma. Along the profile of v the data term is the # prediction profile, and the profile interval the confidence interval of the prediction. .predict <- function(t) {   objv <- normL2(data, g*x*p, times = t, attrName = "data") +     datapointL2(name = "cellular", time = t, parameter = "v", sigma = 0.1,                 attrName = "validation", condition = "closed")   pred <- (g*x*p)(t, bestfit, deriv = FALSE)[["closed"]]   v0   <- unname(pred[pred[, "time"] == t, "cellular"])   fit  <- trust(objv, c(v = v0, bestfit), rinit = 1)   profile(objv, fit$argument, "v", method = "integrate",           stepControl = list(stop = "data"),           algoControl = list(reoptimize = TRUE)) }  prof20 <- .predict(20) plotProfile(prof20, mode %in% c("validation", "data")) + labs(x = "cellular bile acid at t = 20") confint(prof20, val.column = "data")  # the interval at several times, drawn as a band around the prediction .band <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0:10, seq(12.5, 50, by = 2.5)), function(t)   data.frame(time = t, confint(.predict(t), val.column = "data")[c("lower", "upper")])))  .pred <- subset(as.data.frame((g*x*p)(times, bestfit, deriv = FALSE)),                 condition == "closed" & name == "cellular") ggplot(.pred, aes(time, value)) +   geom_ribbon(data = .band, aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),               inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +   geom_line() +   geom_point(data = .band, aes(y = lower), shape = 4) +   geom_point(data = .band, aes(y = upper), shape = 4) +   theme_dMod2() +   labs(x = "time", y = "cellular bile acid", title = "closed junctions: prediction band")

title: 1. Setting up models
text: TNFα activates receptor, receptor IKK, IKK phosphorylates IκBα NFκB complex. Free NFκB enters nucleus induces IκBα A20, two negative feedbacks. addReaction() adds reaction eqnlist; assignCompartment() places nuclear species nucleus relative volume Vnuc. Rates concentration rates compartment educts (products without net educts): \[\dot x_i = \frac{1}{V_i} \sum_r S_{ri}\, V_{c(r)}\, v_r(x, p),\] \(S_{ri}\) stoichiometry \(V_{c(r)}\) volume compartment reaction \(r\). Expressions follow expression language cppDE; factors eta_ relate two rates.
code: reactions <- eqnlist() |>   assignCompartment(nIkb = "nucleus", pnNfk = "nucleus", nNfk = "nucleus", nNfkIkb = "nucleus",                     volume = "Vnuc") |>   # receptors activated by TNFα in the medium, which they do not use up   addReaction("TNF", "TNF + TNFR", "uptake * TNF", "receptor activation") |>   addReaction("TNFR", "", "deact_TNFR * TNFR", "receptor deactivation") |>   # IKK cycle: activation by receptors, inhibited by A20, and basal; inactivation and recovery   addReaction("Ikk", "pIkk", "act_Ikk_by_TNF / (1 + A20 / inh_Ikk) * TNFR * Ikk", "IKK activation") |>   addReaction("Ikk", "pIkk", "act_Ikk_Base * Ikk", "basal IKK activation") |>   addReaction("pIkk", "ppIkk", "act_pIkk * pIkk", "IKK phosphorylation") |>   addReaction("ppIkk", "iIkk", "deact_ppIkk * ppIkk", "IKK inactivation") |>   addReaction("iIkk", "Ikk", "trigger_iIkk * iIkk", "IKK recovery") |>   # IκBα and NFκB phosphorylated in their complex, basal and by pIKK and ppIKK   addReaction("NfkIkb", "NfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_Base * NfkIkb", "basal IkBa phosphorylation") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "NfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * pIkk * NfkIkb", "IkBa phosphorylation by pIKK") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "NfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * ppIkk * NfkIkb",               "IkBa phosphorylation by ppIKK") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "pNfkIkb", "act_Nfk_Base * NfkIkb", "basal NFkB phosphorylation") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "pNfkIkb", "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * pIkk * NfkIkb", "NFkB phosphorylation by pIKK") |>   addReaction("NfkIkb", "pNfkIkb", "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * ppIkk * NfkIkb",               "NFkB phosphorylation by ppIKK") |>   addReaction("pNfkIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_Base * eta_act_Ikb_Base_c_pNfkIkb * pNfkIkb",               "basal IkBa phosphorylation, pNFkB complex") |>   addReaction("pNfkIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * eta_act_Ikb_c_pNfkIkb * pIkk * pNfkIkb",               "IkBa phosphorylation by pIKK, pNFkB complex") |>   addReaction("pNfkIkb", "pNfkpIkb",               "act_Ikb_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * eta_act_Ikb_c_pNfkIkb * ppIkk * pNfkIkb",               "IkBa phosphorylation by ppIKK, pNFkB complex") |>   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Nfk_Base * eta_act_Nfk_Base_c_NfkpIkb * NfkpIkb",               "basal NFkB phosphorylation, pIkBa complex") |>   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "pNfkpIkb", "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * eta_act_Nfk_c_NfkpIkb * pIkk * NfkpIkb",               "NFkB phosphorylation by pIKK, pIkBa complex") |>   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "pNfkpIkb",               "act_Nfk_by_Ikk * eta_s_ppIkk * eta_act_Nfk_c_NfkpIkb * ppIkk * NfkpIkb",               "NFkB phosphorylation by ppIKK, pIkBa complex") |>   # release of NFκB from the complex with phosphorylated IκBα, and complex formation   addReaction("NfkpIkb", "Nfk + pIkb", "split_NfkpIkb * NfkpIkb", "release of NFkB") |>   addReaction("pNfkpIkb", "pNfk + pIkb", "split_NfkIkb * eta_split_pNfkpIkb * pNfkpIkb",               "release of pNFkB") |>   addReaction("Nfk + Ikb", "NfkIkb", "form_complex * Nfk * Ikb", "complex formation") |>   # IκBα transcript, induced by nuclear NFκB, the translation, and degradation of pIκBα   addReaction("", "mIkb", "prod_mIkb_by_nNfk * nNfk", "IkBa transcription") |>   addReaction("mIkb", "", "degrad_mIkb * mIkb", "IkBa transcript degradation") |>   addReaction("", "Ikb", "prod_Ikb * mIkb", "IkBa translation") |>   addReaction("pIkb", "", "degrad_Ikb * pIkb", "pIkBa degradation") |>   # nuclear import, dephosphorylation of pNFκB, the nuclear complex and the complex export   addReaction("Ikb", "nIkb", "int_Nfk * eta_int_Ikb * Ikb", "IkBa import") |>   addReaction("pNfk", "pnNfk", "int_Nfk * eta_int_pNfk * pNfk", "pNFkB import") |>   addReaction("Nfk", "nNfk", "int_Nfk * Nfk", "NFkB import") |>   addReaction("pnNfk", "nNfk", "deact_pnNfk * pnNfk", "nuclear pNFkB dephosphorylation") |>   addReaction("nIkb + nNfk", "nNfkIkb", "form_complex * eta_form_complex_nuc * nNfk * nIkb",               "nuclear complex formation") |>   addReaction("nNfkIkb", "NfkIkb", "ext_nNfkIkb * nNfkIkb", "complex export") |>   # A20 transcript with two delay stages, and A20 protein   addReaction("", "RnaA20_1", "build_RnaA20 * nNfk", "A20 transcription") |>   addReaction("RnaA20_1", "RnaA20_2", "shuttle_RnaA20 * RnaA20_1", "A20 transcript, delay 1") |>   addReaction("RnaA20_2", "RnaA20", "shuttle_RnaA20 * RnaA20_2", "A20 transcript, delay 2") |>   addReaction("RnaA20", "", "degrad_RnaA20 * RnaA20", "A20 transcript degradation") |>   addReaction("", "A20", "build_A20 * RnaA20", "A20 translation") |>   addReaction("A20", "", "degrad_A20 * A20", "A20 degradation") length(reactions$states) #> [1] 23 as.eqnvec(reactions)[c("NfkIkb", "nNfk", "TNF", "TNFR")] #> Idx  Inner <- Outer #>   1 NfkIkb <- -1*(act_Ikb_Base*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Ikb_by_Ikk*pIkk*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Ikb_by_Ikk*eta_s_ppIkk*ppIkk*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Nfk_Base*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Nfk_by_Ikk*pIkk*NfkIkb)-1*(act_Nfk_by_Ikk*eta_s_ppIkk*ppIkk*NfkIkb)+1*(form_complex*Nfk*Ikb)+1*(ext_nNfkIkb*nNfkIkb)*(Vnuc/1) #>   2   nNfk <- 1*(int_Nfk*Nfk)*(1/Vnuc)+1*(deact_pnNfk*pnNfk)-1*(form_complex*eta_form_complex_nuc*nNfk*nIkb) #>   3    TNF <- 0 #>   4   TNFR <- 1*(uptake*TNF)-1*(deact_TNFR*TNFR)

title: 1. Setting up models
text: Readouts (live-cell imaging, immunoblots) sums species scale s_, offset off_ , imaging, bleaching rate tau_, natural log scale: \[y = \log(s\, x + o) - \tau t .\]
code: nfkbCyt <- "NfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfkpIkb + pNfk + Nfk" ikbCyt <- "NfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfkpIkb + pIkb + Ikb" pNfkb <- "pNfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfk" # log of scale times species plus offset; the imaging signals bleach exponentially, which # subtracts a term linear in time logOf <- function(stem, species, bleach = FALSE)   sprintf(if (bleach) "log(s_%1$s * (%2$s) + off_%1$s) - tau_%1$s * time"           else "log(s_%1$s * (%2$s) + off_%1$s)", stem, species)  observables <- eqnvec(   nucNFkB        = logOf("nucNFkB", "pnNfk + nNfk + nNfkIkb", bleach = TRUE),   cytNFkB        = logOf("cytNFkB", nfkbCyt, bleach = TRUE),   A20GFP         = logOf("A20GFP", "A20", bleach = TRUE),   IkBa           = logOf("IkBa", "NfkIkb + pNfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pIkb + Ikb"),   pNFkB          = logOf("pNFkB", pNfkb),   pIkBa          = logOf("pIkBa", "NfkpIkb + pNfkpIkb + pIkb"),   pIKK           = logOf("pIKK", "pIkk + ppIkk"),   ipIkBa_ibIkBa  = logOf("ipIkBa_ibIkBa", "NfkIkb + pNfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pIkb + Ikb"),   ipNFkB_ibNFkB  = logOf("ipNFkB_ibNFkB", nfkbCyt),   ipNFkB_ibpIkBa = logOf("ipNFkB_ibpIkBa", "NfkpIkb + pNfkpIkb"),   ipNFkB_ibpNFkB = logOf("ipNFkB_ibpNFkB", pNfkb),   ipIkBa_ibpNFkB = logOf("ipIkBa_ibpNFkB", "pNfkpIkb + pNfkIkb"),   ipIkBa_ibNFkB  = logOf("ipIkBa_ibNFkB", "NfkIkb + NfkpIkb + pNfkIkb + pNfkpIkb"),   ratioNFkBIkBa  = sprintf("log((%s) / (%s))", nfkbCyt, ikbCyt))

text: NFκB IKK conserved, \(f(x, p) = 0\) determines resting state totals: Pimpl() solves steady state numerically, totals totalNfk totalIkk parameters, TNF 0, exact derivatives root (Methods > Steady states). steadyStates() analytic alternative.
code: conservedQuantities(reactions) #> $TNF #> [1] "1*TNF" #>  #> $totalIkk #> [1] "1*Ikk+1*pIkk+1*ppIkk+1*iIkk" #>  #> $totalNfk #> [1] "1*NfkIkb+1*NfkpIkb+1*pNfkIkb+1*pNfkpIkb+1*Nfk+1*pNfk+1*Vnuc*pnNfk+1*Vnuc*nNfk+1*Vnuc*nNfkIkb" # the cells rest before TNFα is added: a steady state with the amounts of NFκB and IKK conserved; # an unstable one is returned rather than refused, the objective below keeps it stable pSS <- Pimpl(reactions, modelname = "oppelt_ss", compile = FALSE,              derivMode = "forward-forward", controlsPTC = list(stability = FALSE))

title: 1. Setting up models
text: odemodel() generates C++ code ODE sensitivity equations, Xs() prdfn x, Y() observables g error model e; compile = FALSE defers one compile(). backend "cppDE" (default) integrates BDF, "Sundials" uses CVODES, "deSolve" deSolve. step accepted \(\bigl(\tfrac1n \sum_i \varepsilon_i^2 / (\mathrm{atol} + \mathrm{rtol}\,|x_i|)^2\bigr)^{1/2} \le 1\): model.R sets rtol = 1e-8, atol = 1e-10, since log observables magnify errors small states.
code: # TNFα is added at time 0 events <- addEvent(NULL, var = "TNF", time = 0, value = "dose_TNF", method = "replace") model <- odemodel(reactions, events = events, modelname = "oppelt_ode", compile = FALSE) x <- Xs(model, options = list(atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-8)) g <- Y(observables, x, modelname = "oppelt_obs", compile = FALSE) e <- Y(errors, g, modelname = "oppelt_err", compile = FALSE)

text: HepG2 cells without compound: 312 points two conditions.
code: # the data set of the publication, values on the natural log scale; the imaging readouts have # no standard deviation, the error model supplies one raw <- read.csv("data/oppelt2018.csv", skip = 15) readouts <- c(   "nuclear NFkB"       = "nucNFkB",   "cytoplasmic NFkB"   = "cytNFkB",   "A20"                = "A20GFP",   "IkBa"               = "IkBa",   "pIkBa"              = "pIkBa",   "pNFkB"              = "pNFkB",   "pIKK"               = "pIKK",   "IP:IkBa | IB:IkBa"  = "ipIkBa_ibIkBa",   "IP:NFkB | IB:NFkB"  = "ipNFkB_ibNFkB",   "IP:NFkB | IB:pIkBa" = "ipNFkB_ibpIkBa",   "IP:NFkB | IB:pNFkB" = "ipNFkB_ibpNFkB",   "IP:IkBa | IB:pNFkB" = "ipIkBa_ibpNFkB",   "NFkB/IkBa ratio"    = "ratioNFkBIkBa") raw$name[grepl("^IP:IkBa \\| IB:NFkB", raw$name)] <- "ipIkBa_ibNFkB" raw$name <- ifelse(raw$name %in% names(readouts), readouts[raw$name], raw$name) raw$sigma[raw$name %in% c("nucNFkB", "cytNFkB", "A20GFP")] <- NA  # HepG2 cells without a compound, on the first blot scale hepg2 <- subset(raw, cell == "HepG2" & scale == 1 & compound == "no") hepg2$condition <- ifelse(hepg2$treatment == "TNF", "TNF", "control") data <- as.datalist(hepg2[c("name", "time", "value", "sigma", "condition", "treatment")],                     splitBy = "condition", keepCovariates = "treatment") table(hepg2$name, hepg2$condition) #>                  #>                  control TNF #>   A20GFP              19  19 #>   cytNFkB             26  26 #>   IkBa                13  15 #>   ipIkBa_ibIkBa        0   9 #>   ipIkBa_ibNFkB        0   9 #>   ipIkBa_ibpNFkB       0   9 #>   ipNFkB_ibNFkB        0   9 #>   ipNFkB_ibpIkBa       0   9 #>   ipNFkB_ibpNFkB       0   9 #>   nucNFkB             26  26 #>   pIkBa               11  15 #>   pIKK                14  18 #>   pNFkB               12  17 #>   ratioNFkBIkBa        0   1 covariates(data) #>         condition treatment #> TNF           TNF       TNF #> control   control        no plotData(data, name %in% c("nucNFkB", "cytNFkB", "A20GFP", "IkBa", "pIkBa", "pIKK")) +   ggplot2::labs(x = "time [min]", y = "log signal [a.u.]")

title: 1. Setting up models
text: define() insert() build assignments parfn p: define("x <- x", x = ...) takes every parameter pSS, x, g e except states, whose values come steady state; insert("x <- exp(x)", x = ...) puts every symbol log scale; define("TNF <- 0") sets TNFα 0 steady state; branch(covariates(data)) copies assignments per condition, define(..., conditionMatch =) sets dose. compile() builds one shared object getOption("dMod2.outdir"), reusing unchanged objects.

title: 1. Setting up models
text: normL2(data, prd, e) returns \(-2 \log L\) gradient Gauss-Newton Hessian (Methods > Likelihood prior). constraintL2() adds Gaussian prior log scale, also start distribution Optimization: mean 0 standard deviation 4 default, narrower magnitude known: pSS also returns unstable roots (controlsPTC = list(stability = FALSE)); constraintStability() zero stable resting state reaches 100 per eigenvalue stability boundary, needs Pimpl(derivMode = "forward-forward") (Methods > Steady states).
code: # a weak prior on the log scale: mean 0, standard deviation 4, a factor of about 55, narrower # where the order of magnitude is known before the fit outer <- getParameters(prd) mu <- structure(rep(0, length(outer)), names = outer) sigma <- structure(rep(4, length(outer)), names = outer) # bleaching removes at most a few percent of the signal over the time of the data bleach <- grep("^tau_", outer, value = TRUE) mu[bleach] <- log(0.1 / max(as.data.frame(data)$time)) sigma[bleach] <- 2 # the imaging readouts scatter by about 5% noise <- grep("^sigma_", outer, value = TRUE) mu[noise] <- log(0.05) sigma[noise] <- 1 # without TNFα, IKK, IκBα and NFκB are activated far more slowly than after it basal <- grep("_Base$", outer, value = TRUE) mu[basal] <- -8 sigma[basal] <- 2 # transcripts and A20 are made and degraded within about an hour turnover <- c("shuttle_RnaA20", "degrad_RnaA20", "build_A20", "degrad_A20", "degrad_mIkb") mu[turnover] <- log(1 / 60) sigma[turnover] <- 2 # IKK recovers from its inactive form over hours mu["trigger_iIkk"] <- log(1 / 240) sigma["trigger_iIkk"] <- 2 # the cells rest: a term that is zero on a stable resting state and reaches 100 where it loses # stability, on a ramp of a tenth of the inverse time span of the data, wide enough for the model # of a fit step to see the boundary before the step crosses it rampWidth <- 0.1 / max(as.data.frame(data)$time) stability <- constraintStability(pSS, p, width = rampWidth) obj <- normL2(data, prd, e) + constraintL2(mu, sigma = sigma) + stability # the stopping tolerances of trust(), above the error that the solver settings leave: ftol and # mtol an order of magnitude above that of the value (about 2e-6), gtol two above that of the # gradient (about 8e-5) tolerances <- list(ftol = 1e-4, mtol = 1e-4, gtol = 1e-2)

addReaction("nNfkIkb", "NfkIkb", "ext_nNfkIkb * nNfkIkb", "complex export") |>   addReaction("", "RnaA20_1", "build_RnaA20 * nNfk", "A20 transcription") |>   addReaction("RnaA20_1", "RnaA20_2", modelname = "oppelt_red_ode", compile = FALSE) xReduced <- Xs(modelReduced, options = list(atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-8)) gReduced <- Y(observablesReduced, xReduced, modelname = "oppelt_red_obs", compile = FALSE) eReduced <- Y(errors, gReduced, modelname = "oppelt_red_err", compile = FALSE) resting <- c(NfkIkb = "totalNfk", Ikk = "totalIkk") resting <- c(resting, structure(rep("0", length(setdiff(reactionsReduced$states, names(resting)))),                                 names = setdiff(reactionsReduced$states, names(resting))))  # the fixed values of the publication (Tables S8 and S9): fast processes at 1000 per minute, slow # receptor deactivation and NFκB import, offsets and bleaching that vanish fixedReduced <- c(deact_TNFR = 1e-3, int_Nfk = 1e-2, deact_pnNfk = 1000, form_complex_nuc = 1000,                   ext_nNfkIkb = 1000, off_IkBa = 0, off_ipIkBa_ibIkBa = 0, tau_A20GFP = 0) trafoReduced <- eqnvec() |>   define("x <- x", x = setdiff(getParameters(xReduced, = "TNF") pReduced <- P(trafoReduced, modelname = "oppelt_red_par", compile = FALSE) compile(gReduced, xReduced, pReduced, eReduced, output = "oppelt_red",         cores = getOption("dMod2.cores")) prdReduced <- gReduced * xReduced * pReduced # the prior of model.R on the parameters that remain outerReduced <- getParameters(prdReduced) # the basal phosphorylation in the pNFκB complex at the product of the two rates it replaces muReduced <- c(mu, act_Ikb_complex = mu[["act_Ikb_Base"]] + mu[["eta_act_Ikb_Base_c_pNfkIkb"]])[outerReduced] sigmaReduced <- c(sigma, act_Ikb_complex = sqrt(sigma[["act_Ikb_Base"]]^2 +                                                   sigma[["eta_act_Ikb_Base_c_pNfkIkb"]]^2))[outerReduced] gaugeReduced <- gauge[intersect(names(gauge), outerReduced)] +              full$argument[["eta_act_Ikb_Base_c_pNfkIkb"]])[outerReduced] freeReduced <- setdiff(outerReduced, names(gaugeReduced)) fit <- trust(objReduced, start[freeReduced], fixed = gaugeReduced, rinit = 0.1, rmax = 10,              iterlim = 1000, tolControl = tolerances) set.seed(1) fitsReduced <- mstrust(objReduced, fit$argument, fixed = gaugeReduced, sd = 1, fits = 50, gradients$reverse)) / max(abs(gradients$forward)) max(abs(s$gradients$forward - s$gradients$reverse)) / max(abs(s$gradients$forward)) #> [1] 0.0003422859 # the shortest of ten evaluations, in seconds cost <- function(...) {   args <- c(list(best, fixed = gauge), list(...))   min(replicate(10, system.time(do.call(dataTerm, args))[["elapsed"]])) } timing <- c(value = cost(deriv = FALSE), forward = cost(sweep = "forward"),             reverse = cost(sweep = "reverse"),             `forward-reverse` = cost(sweep = "reverse", deriv2 = TRUE)) timing s$timing #>           value         forward         reverse forward-reverse  #>           0.007           0.185           0.024           1.014 # one evaluation of the exact Hessian forward over forward, with second-order sensitivities in all # pairs of parameters: the time and the peak memory of the process in GB peak <- function() as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", grep("^VmHWM", readLines("/proc/self/status"), value = TRUE))) / 2^20 before <- peak() forwardForward <- system.time(ff <- dataTerm(best, fixed = gauge, sweep = "forward", deriv2 = TRUE))[["elapsed"]] memory <- c(before = before, forwardForward = peak()) c(seconds = forwardForward, memory) c(seconds = s$forwardForward, s$memory) #>        seconds         before forwardForward  #>     16.0610000      0.6090393      0.7765503 exact <- dataTerm(best, fixed = gauge, sweep = "reverse", deriv2 = TRUE)$hessian # the two exact Hessians agree up to the error of the solver max(abs(ff$hessian[rownames(exact), colnames(exact)] - s$exact)) / max(abs(s$exact)) #> [1] 4.871075e-10 eig <- data.frame(rank = rep(seq_len(nrow(s$hessians)), 2),                   value = c(s$hessians$exact, s$hessians$gaussNewton),                   Hessian = rep(c("exact", "Gauss-Newton"), each = nrow(s$hessians))) ggplot2::ggplot(eig, ggplot2::aes(rank, value, color = Hessian)) +   ggplot2::geom_point() +   ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-3, base = 10),                               breaks = c(-1e-1, 0, 1e-2, 1, 1e2, 1e4)) +   ggplot2::labs(x = "rank", y = "eigenvalue") +   theme_dMod2()

code: library(dMod2) dir.create("build", showWarnings = FALSE) # generated sources and shared objects in build/, reused when nothing changed options(dMod2.outdir = "build") cores <- max(1L, min(20L, parallel::detectCores() - 2L)) nstart <- 100L # second derivatives forward over reverse for FOCEI, forward over forward for the reported Hessian dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse")  # fits are saved in results/cache.rds under a key and read from there when present; delete the # file to fit everything again cached <- function(key, expr) {   file <- "results/cache.rds"   dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)   store <- if (file.exists(file)) readRDS(file) else list()   if (is.null(store[[key]])) {     store[[key]] <- expr     saveRDS(store, file)   }   store[[key]] } # a fit of em() cached without the model, which an evaluation at the fit estimates restores cachedEm <- function(key, obj, random, start, control = list(), ...) {   model <- c("design", "prdfn", "errfn", "data")   f <- cached(key, { f <- em(obj, random, start, control = control, ...); f[model] <- NULL; f })   f[model] <- em(obj, random, f, control = modifyList(control, list(trustControl = list(iterlim = 0),                                                                     boundary = FALSE)),                  verbose = FALSE)[model]   f }

title: Theophylline, warfarin and mavoglurant
text: starts: initial values log scale nstart - 1 draws around , N(0, 0.5) per parameter. Every fit runs one core, nstart fits cores cores .
code: drawStarts <- function(init, n = nstart) {   set.seed(1)   rbind(init, t(vapply(seq_len(n - 1L), function(i) init + rnorm(length(init), 0, 0.5), init))) }  # dMod2 from every start; the fits as a table of -2 log L, convergence, seconds and estimates runDMod2 <- function(obj, random, starts, method) {   out <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(starts)), function(i) {     options(dMod2.cores = 1L)     set.seed(i)     t <- system.time(f <- tryCatch(em(obj, random, starts[i, ], method = method, verbose = FALSE),                                    error = function(e) NULL))[["elapsed"]]     if (is.null(f)) return(list(value = NA_real_, converged = FALSE, seconds = t, argument = NULL))     list(value = f$value, converged = isTRUE(f$converged), seconds = t, argument = f$argument)   }, mc.cores = cores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)   data.frame(package = "dMod2", start = seq_along(out), value = vapply(out, `[[`, 0, "value"),              converged = vapply(out, `[[`, TRUE, "converged"), seconds = vapply(out, `[[`, 0, "seconds")) }  # per method the best value, the starts within 0.1 of it, the failed and unconverged fits, the # median and total seconds per fit; `runs` a named list of the tables of runDMod2() summarizeStarts <- function(runs) {   do.call(rbind, lapply(names(runs), function(m) {     r <- runs[[m]]     best <- min(r$value, na.rm = TRUE)     data.frame(method = m, best = best, hits = sum(r$value - best < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),                failed = sum(is.na(r$value)), unconverged = sum(!r$converged & !is.na(r$value)),                medianSeconds = stats::median(r$seconds), totalSeconds = sum(r$seconds))   })) }  # the waterfall of every method, a panel each, and the seconds per fit plotStarts <- function(runs, title) {   w <- plotValues(runs, pseudoLog = TRUE) + ggplot2::labs(title = title)   seconds <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(runs), function(m) data.frame(method = m, seconds = runs[[m]]$seconds)))   s <- ggplot2::ggplot(seconds, ggplot2::aes(method, seconds)) + ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +     ggplot2::scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_log()) +     ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "seconds per fit, one core") + theme_dMod2()   cowplot::plot_grid(w, s, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(2, 1)) }  # -2 log L of FOCEI at given estimates, the definition under which the SAEM fits are compared focei <- function(obj, random, pars)   em(obj, random, pars, control = list(trustControl = list(iterlim = 0)), verbose = FALSE)$value  # the multistarts of FOCEI and SAEM of one model, and the best SAEM fit with -2 log L of FOCEI at # the SAEM estimates; `saem` the model SAEM fits compareMethods <- function(runs, label, saem) {   runs <- list(FOCEI = runs$focei, SAEM = runs$saem)   print(summarizeStarts(runs))   print(plotStarts(runs, label))   sfit <- cachedEm(paste(label, "dMod2 saem best"), saem$obj, saem$random, saem$starts[which.min(runs$SAEM$value), ],                    method = "saem", verbose = FALSE)   print(round(sfit$argument, 4))   print(c(SAEM = focei(saem$obj, saem$random, sfit$argument)))   invisible(NULL) }

code: data(Theoph, package = "datasets") Theoph$Subject <- as.character(Theoph$Subject) theoData <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "cp", time = Theoph$Time, value = Theoph$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                    condition = Theoph$Subject)) theoNet <- eqnlist() |>   assignCompartment(Ag = "depot") |>   assignCompartment(Cc = "central", volume = "V") |>   setCompartmentVolume(unit = "1") |>   addReaction("Ag", "Cc", "Ka * Ag", "absorption") |>   addReaction("Cc", "", "Cl * Cc", "elimination", rateCompartment = "unit") theoNet #>  #> Compartments: #>   depot (V=1) #>   central (V=V) #>   unit (V=1) #> States by compartment: #>   central: Cc #>   depot: Ag #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product    Rate Description #> 1          Ag ->      Cc Ka * Ag  absorption #> 2          Cc ->         Cl * Cc elimination theoX <- Xs(odemodel(theoNet, modelname = "pm_theoph", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm)) theoG <- Y(c(cp = "Cc"), theoX, modelname = "pm_theoph_g", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) theoE <- Y(c(cp = "sigma"), theoG, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "pm_theoph_e", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE,            derivMode = dm) subjects <- sort(unique(Theoph$Subject)) theoTable <- data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = tapply(Theoph$Dose * Theoph$Wt, Theoph$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects],                         weight = tapply(Theoph$Wt, Theoph$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects], row.names = subjects) theoTrafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "Ag", "Cc", "sigma")), table = theoTable) theoTrafo <- insert(theoTrafo, "Ag <- dose", dose = dose) theoTrafo <- insert(theoTrafo, "Cc <- 0") theoTrafo <- insert(theoTrafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma")) theoTrafo <- insert(theoTrafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)) theoP <- P(theoTrafo, method = "explicit", modelname = "pm_theoph_p", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) compileSeconds <- c(theophylline = system.time(compile(theoX, theoG, theoE, theoP,                                                        output = "pm_theoph_all"))[["elapsed"]]) theoObj <- normL2(theoData, theoG * theoX * theoP, errmodel = theoE) theoRandom <- randomEffects(theoP) theoStarts <- drawStarts(c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma = log(0.5), omega_Ka_Ka = log(0.3),                            omega_V_V = log(0.3), omega_Cl_Cl = log(0.3)))  theoRuns title: Theophylline, warfarin and mavoglurant
text: 32 subjects, one oral dose; plasma concentration cp prothrombin complex activity pca, whose synthesis concentration inhibits (turnover model maximal inhibition 1). Volume, clearance, baseline turnover rate activity vary subjects.
code: data(warfarin) warfData <- as.datalist(warfarin, splitBy = "condition", keepCovariates = c("dose", "wt", "age", "sex")) warfNet <- eqnlist() |>   assignCompartment(Ag = "depot") |>   assignCompartment(Cc = "central", volume = "V") |>   assignCompartment(PCA = "effect") |>   setCompartmentVolume(unit = "1") |>   addReaction("Ag", "Cc", "Ka * Ag", "absorption") |>   addReaction("Cc", "", "Cl * Cc", "elimination", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("", "PCA", "kout * pca0 * IC50 / (IC50 + Cc)", "synthesis") |>   addReaction("PCA", "", "kout * PCA", "degradation") warfNet #>  #> Compartments: #>   depot (V=1) #>   central (V=V) #>   effect (V=1) #>   unit (V=1) #> States by compartment: #>   central: Cc #>   depot: Ag #>   effect: PCA #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product                             Rate Description #> 1          Ag ->      Cc                          Ka * Ag  absorption #> 2          Cc ->                                  Cl * Cc elimination #> 3             ->     PCA kout * pca0 * IC50 / (IC50 + Cc)   synthesis #> 4         PCA ->                               kout * PCA degradation warfX <- Xs(odemodel(warfNet, modelname = "pm_warf", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm)) warfG <- Y(c(cp = "Cc", pca = "PCA"), warfX, modelname = "pm_warf_g", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE,            derivMode = dm) # the error of cp combined from an absolute and a relative part, positive also where the solver # leaves cp at or below 0 warfE <- Y(c(cp = "sqrt(sigma_cp_abs^2 + (sigma_cp_rel * cp)^2)", pca = "sigma_pca"), warfG,            attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "pm_warf_e", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) warfTable <- attr(warfData, "condition.grid") warfTable$ID <- rownames(warfTable) warfTrafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "IC50", "kout", "pca0", "Ag", "Cc", "PCA",                                                   "sigma_cp_abs", "sigma_cp_rel", "sigma_pca")), table = warfTable) warfTrafo <- insert(warfTrafo, "Ag <- d", d = dose) warfTrafo <- insert(warfTrafo, "Cc <- 0") warfTrafo <- insert(warfTrafo, "PCA <- pca0") warfTrafo <- insert(warfTrafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "IC50", "kout", "pca0", "sigma_cp_abs",                                                     "sigma_cp_rel", "sigma_pca")) warfTrafo <- insert(warfTrafo, V + Cl + pca0 + kout ~ 1 + (1 | ID)) warfP <- P(warfTrafo, method = "explicit", modelname = "pm_warf_p", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) compileSeconds["warfarin"] <- system.time(compile(warfX, warfG, warfE, warfP, output = "pm_warf_all"))[["elapsed"]] warfObj <- normL2(warfData, warfG * warfX * warfP, errmodel = warfE) warfRandom <- randomEffects(warfP) warfStarts <- drawStarts(c(Ka = 0, V = 2, Cl = -2, IC50 = 0, kout = -3, pca0 = 4.6, sigma_cp_abs = log(0.1),                            sigma_cp_rel = log(0.1),                            sigma_pca = log(5), omega_V_V = log(0.3), omega_Cl_Cl = log(0.3),                            omega_pca0_pca0 = log(0.3), omega_kout_kout = log(0.3))) warfRuns <- cached("Warfarin dMod2", list(focei = runDMod2(warfObj, warfRandom, warfStarts, "focei"),                                            saem = runDMod2(warfObj, warfRandom, warfStarts, "saem"))) warfFit <- cachedEm("Warfarin dMod2 focei best", warfObj, warfRandom,                     warfStarts[which.min(warfRuns$focei$value), ], verbose = FALSE) summary(warfFit) #> EM summary (focei): -2 log L 2395.005082, converged TRUE, 35 iterations #>   without title: Theophylline, warfarin and mavoglurant
text: 120 subjects, infusion 10 min (20 min one occasion) time switch, 78 subjects two occasions. Two compartments; clearances scale weight power 0.75, volumes weight. Clearance, central peripheral volume intercompartmental clearance vary subjects, clearance also occasions subject, (1 | ID:OCC). SAEM fits model without variability occasions.
code: data(mavoglurant) mavoData <- as.datalist(mavoglurant, splitBy = "condition",                         keepCovariates = c("ID", "OCC", "dose", "duration", "AGE", "SEX", "WT", "HT")) mavoNet <- eqnlist() |>   assignCompartment(C1 = "central", volume = "V1") |>   assignCompartment(C2 = "peripheral", volume = "V2") |>   setCompartmentVolume(unit = "1") |>   addReaction("", "C1", "piecewise(dose / duration, time < duration, 0)", "infusion", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("C1", "", "CL * C1", "elimination", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("C1", "C2", "Q * C1", "distribution", rateCompartment = "unit") |>   addReaction("C2", "C1", "Q * C2", "redistribution", rateCompartment = "unit") mavoNet #>  #> Compartments: #>   central (V=V1) #>   peripheral (V=V2) #>   unit (V=1) #> States by compartment: #>   central: C1 #>   peripheral: C2 #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product                                           Rate #> 1             ->      C1 piecewise(dose / duration, time < duration, 0) #> 2          C1 ->                                                CL * C1 #> 3          C1 ->      C2                                         Q * C1 #> 4          C2 ->      C1                                         Q * C2 #>      Description #> 1       infusion #> 2    elimination #> 3   distribution #> 4 redistribution # solver tolerances 1e-10: at the defaults the solver error, absolute in mg/L, moves -2 log L by # about 1e-3, more than the fit resolves mavoX <- Xs(odemodel(mavoNet, modelname = "pm_mavo", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm),             options = list(atol = 1e-10, rtol = 1e-10)) # the dose in mg, the concentration in ng/mL mavoG <- Y(c(cp = "1000 * C1"), mavoX, modelname = "pm_mavo_g", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) mavoE <- Y(c(cp = "sqrt(sigma_abs^2 + (sigma_rel * cp)^2)"), mavoG, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "pm_mavo_e",            compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE, derivMode = dm) mavoTable <- attr(mavoData, "condition.grid") mavoTable$ID <- as.character(mavoTable$ID) mavoTrafo <- function(between) {   tr <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("CL", "V1", "Q", "V2", "C1", "C2", "dose", "duration", "sigma_abs",                                                 "sigma_rel")),                table = mavoTable)   tr <- insert(tr, "dose <- d", d = dose)   tr <- insert(tr, "duration <- u", u = duration)   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- 0", x = c("C1", "C2"))   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- x * (w / 70)^0.75", x = c("CL", "Q"), w = WT)   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- x * w / 70", x = c("V1", "V2"), w = WT)   tr <- insert(tr, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("CL", "V1", "Q", "V2", "sigma_abs", "sigma_rel"))   if (between) tr <- insert(tr, CL ~ 1 + (1 | ID) + (1 | ID:OCC)) else tr <- insert(tr, CL ~ 1 + (1 | ID))   insert(tr, V1 + Q + V2 ~ 1 + (1 | ID)) } mavoP <- P(mavoTrafo(TRUE), method = "explicit", modelname = "pm_mavo_p", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE,            derivMode = dm) mavoP1 <- P(mavoTrafo(FALSE), method = "explicit", modelname = "pm_mavo_p1", compile = FALSE, deriv2 = TRUE,             derivMode = dm) compileSeconds["mavoglurant"] <- system.time(compile(mavoX, mavoG, mavoE, mavoP, mavoP1,                                                      output = "pm_mavo_all"))[["elapsed"]] mavoObj <- normL2(mavoData, mavoG * mavoX * mavoP, errmodel = mavoE) mavoObj1 <- normL2(mavoData, mavoG * mavoX * mavoP1, errmodel = mavoE) mavoRandom <- randomEffects(mavoP) mavoRandom1 <- randomEffects(mavoP1) mavoRandom #> Random effects: 5 terms over ID, ID:OCC #>   block 1 (normal, ID): eta_CL #>   block 2 (normal, ID:OCC): eta_CL_ID_OCC #>   block 3 (normal, ID): eta_V1 #>   block 4 (normal, ID): eta_Q #>   block 5 (normal, ID): eta_V2 #>   fixed effects: CL, V1, Q, V2 mavoInit <- c(CL = log(30), V1 = log(40), Q = log(30), V2 = log(150), sigma_abs = log(1), sigma_rel = log(0.2),               omega_CL_CL = log(0.3),               omega_V1_V1 = log(0.3), omega_Q_Q = log(0.3), omega_V2_V2 = log(0.3)) mavoStarts <- drawStarts(c(mavoInit, omega_CL_ID_OCC_CL_ID_OCC = log(0.15))) mavoStarts1 <- mavoStarts[, names(mavoInit)] mavoRuns <- cached("Mavoglurant dMod2", list(focei = runDMod2(mavoObj, mavoRandom, mavoStarts, "focei"),                                               saem = runDMod2(mavoObj1, mavoRandom1, mavoStarts1, "saem"))) mavoFit <- cachedEm("Mavoglurant dMod2 focei best", mavoObj, mavoRandom,                     mavoStarts[which.min(mavoRuns$focei$value), ], verbose = FALSE) summary(mavoFit) #> EM summary (focei): -2 log L Default FALSE. Every function chain built derivMode = "forward-forward". hessian: objective functions , see table . Default NULL. sweep: objective functions . "forward" (default) propagates sensitivities chain; "reverse" computes gradient one backward pass, whose cost grow number parameters. "reverse" needs every function chain built derivMode = "reverse", "forward-reverse" deriv2 = TRUE. conditions: character vector, conditions evaluate. Default conditions function. env: environment intermediate results. Default NULL, new one. objective function stores prediction prediction returns environment attribute env. cores: number threads ODE solves residual kernel. Default getOption("dMod2.cores", 1L). title: Observation Function — Y
code: ## A prediction function interpolating parameter values piecewise linearly times <- 0:5 grid <- data.frame(name = "A", time = times, row.names = paste0("p", times)) x <- Xd(grid)  ## An observation function g <- Y(c(Aobs = "s*A"), states = "A", parameters = "s",        modelname = "prediction_obs", outdir = tempdir())  ## One parameter transformation per condition innerpars <- c(getParameters(x), getParameters(g)) trafo <- setNames(innerpars, innerpars) p <- P(list(C1 = replaceSymbols(innerpars, paste0(innerpars, "_C1"), trafo),             C2 = replaceSymbols(innerpars, paste0(innerpars, "_C2"), trafo)),        modelname = "prediction_p", outdir = tempdir())  # \donttest{ ## Compile the observation function and the transformations together compile(g, p, output = "prediction_ex") #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC]  outerpars <- getParameters(p) pars <- setNames(seq(0.1, 1, length.out = length(outerpars)), outerpars)  ## Unobserved states, then observables plot((x * p)(times, pars))  plot((g * x * p)(times, pars))  # }

code: f <- eqnlist() f <- addReaction(f, "2*A+B", "C + 2*D", "k1*B*A^2") f <- addReaction(f, "C + A", "B + A", "k2*C*A")  ## Equation list eq <- eqnlist() eq <- addReaction(eq, "A", "pA", "act_A * A * stimulus", "Phosphorylation of A") eq <- addReaction(eq, "pA", "A", "deact_A * pA", "Dephosphorylation of pA") eq <- addReaction(eq, "2*pA", "pA_pA", "form_complex_pA * pA^2", "Complex formation of pA") eq <- addReaction(eq, "B", "pB", "act_B * B * pA_pA", "Phosphorylation of B") eq <- addReaction(eq, "pB", "B", "deact_B * pB", "Dephosphorylation of pB")  ## Data frame of reactions reactions <- getReactions(eq) print(reactions) #>   Check Educt -> Product                   Rate             Description #> 1           A ->      pA   act_A * A * stimulus    Phosphorylation of A #> 2          pA ->       A           deact_A * pA Dephosphorylation of pA #> 3        2*pA ->   pA_pA form_complex_pA * pA^2 Complex formation of pA #> 4           B ->      pB      act_B * B * pA_pA    Phosphorylation of B #> 5          pB ->       B           deact_B * pB Dephosphorylation of pB  ## Conserved quantities print(conservedQuantities(eq)) #> $total_1 #> [1] "0.5*A+0.5*pA+1*pA_pA" #>  #> $total_2 #> [1] "1*B+1*pB" #>   ## Fluxes fluxes <- getFluxes(eq) print(fluxes) #> $A #>        Phosphorylation of A     Dephosphorylation of pA  #> "-1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"         "+1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>  #> $pA #>          Phosphorylation of A       Dephosphorylation of pA  #>    "1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"           "-1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>       Complex formation of pA  #> "-2*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $pA_pA #>      Complex formation of pA  #> "1*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $B #>     Phosphorylation of B  Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "-1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"      "+1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>  #> $pB #>    Phosphorylation of B Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"     "-1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>   ## Subsetting subeq1 <- subset(eq, "pB" %in% Product) print(subeq1) #> Conserved quantities: #>   pA_pA = 1*pA_pA #>   total_2 = 1*B+1*pB #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product              Rate          Description #> 1           B ->      pB act_B * B * pA_pA Phosphorylation of B subeq2 <- subset(eq, grepl("not_available", Description)) print(subeq2) #>  #> NULL  ## Equation vector of the ODE f <- as.eqnvec(eq) print(f) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(act_A*A*stimulus)+1*(deact_A*pA) #>   2     B <- -1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)+1*(deact_B*pB) #>   3    pA <- 1*(act_A*A*stimulus)-1*(deact_A*pA)-2*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   4 pA_pA <- 1*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   5    pB <- 1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)-1*(deact_B*pB)

title: Fit an alignment model — align
code: ## Five time points on six gels, each gel with a separate scale and an additive background set.seed(1) d <- expand.grid(time = c("0", "10", "30", "60", "120"), gel = paste0("G", 1:6),                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE) truth <- c(0.02, 1, 4, 2, 0.5)[match(d$time, c("0", "10", "30", "60", "120"))] d$value <- (rlnorm(6, 7, 0.5)[match(d$gel, unique(d$gel))] * truth + 50) * rlnorm(nrow(d), 0, 0.1)  # \donttest{ old <- options(dMod2.outdir = tempdir()) ## every symbol positive, on the log scale of the predictor; one value per time point, ## one scale per gel logs <- c("yi <- exp(yi)", "sj <- exp(sj)", "bj <- exp(bj)", "sigmaR <- exp(sigmaR)") m <- alignmentModel(d, model = "yi * sj + bj", errmodel = "sigmaR * prediction",                     biological = yi ~ time, scaling = sj ~ gel, error = bj + sigmaR ~ 1,                     trafo = logs) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC -fopenmp] ## a background varying between gels: a list of formulas for one role m2 <- alignmentModel(d, model = "yi * sj + bj", errmodel = "sigmaR * prediction",                      biological = yi ~ time, scaling = list(sj ~ gel, bj ~ 1 + (1 | gel)),                      error = sigmaR ~ 1, trafo = logs) m #> alignmentModel: 30 readings, model yi * sj + bj, error sigmaR * prediction #>   yi         biological    5 parameters, yi = exp(yi) #>   sj         scaling       6 parameters, sj = exp(sj) #>   bj         error         1 parameter, bj = exp(bj) #>   sigmaR     error         1 parameter, sigmaR = exp(sigmaR) #>   mean of yi normalized in 1 block of experiments m2 #> alignmentModel: 30 readings, model yi * sj + bj, error sigmaR * prediction #>   yi         biological    5 parameters, yi = exp(yi) #>   sj         scaling       6 parameters, sj = exp(sj) #>   bj         scaling       1 parameter, bj = exp(bj), random over gel #>   sigmaR     error         1 parameter, sigmaR = exp(sigmaR) #>   mean of yi normalized in 1 block of experiments fit <- align(m, fits = 4) fit #> alignment: 30 readings, 5 biological values, 12 parameters #>   restricted likelihood (REML, 2 rounds): -2 log L 389.06, AIC 413.06 #>   maximum likelihood fits, REML from the best: -2 log L 329.79 329.79 329.79 329.79 fit$aligned #>   time symbol   estimate         se      value       sigma #> 1    0     yi -3.2127997 0.18302237 0.04024378 0.007365512 #> 2   10     yi  0.4499769 0.05497631 1.56827596 0.086218023 #> 3   30     yi  1.7783403 0.05924187 5.92002292 0.350713229 #> 4   60     yi  1.1659908 0.05670480 3.20910085 0.181971415 #> 5  120     yi -0.1815083 0.05135481 0.83401135 0.042830490 plotAligned(fit)  options(old) # }

title: Compare nested mixed-effects fits — anova.em
code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## the nested model without a random effect on V p0 <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,         modelname = "theoph_p0", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(p0, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] fit0 <- em(normL2(data, g * x * p0, errmodel = err), randomEffects(p0),            init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5))) anova(fit0, fit) #>   model npar    value      AIC      BIC   chisq df            p #> 1     1    6 372.8893 384.8893 402.1861      NA NA           NA #> 2     2    7 359.4032 373.4032 393.5828 13.4861  1 0.0002403376 # }

code: # Generate eqnlist from the constructor S <- matrix(c(-1, 1, 1, -1),             nrow = 2, ncol = 2,             dimnames = list(NULL, c("A", "B")))  rates <- c("k1*A", "k2*B") description <- c("forward", "backward")  f <- eqnlist(smatrix = S, rates = rates, description = description) print(f) #> Conserved quantities: #>   total_1 = 1*A+1*B #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description #> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward #> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward  # Convert to data.frame fdata <- as.data.frame(f) print(fdata) #>   Description Rate  A  B #> 1     forward k1*A -1  1 #> 2    backward k2*B  1 -1  # Flat `volumes`: each distinct expression becomes a compartment c1, c2, ... f <- as.eqnlist(fdata, volumes = c(A = "Vcyt", B = "Vnuc")) print(f) #> Conserved quantities: #>   total_1 = 1*Vcyt*A+1*Vnuc*B #>  #> Compartments: #>   c1 (V=Vcyt) #>   c2 (V=Vnuc) #> States by compartment: #>   c1: A #>   c2: B #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description #> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward #> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward print(as.eqnvec(f)) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc/Vcyt) #>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt/Vnuc)-1*(k2*B) print(as.eqnvec(f, type = "amount")) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc) #>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt)-1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc)  # Named compartments with explicit state assignment f2 <- eqnlist(   smatrix = S, rates = rates, description = description,   compartments = list(cyt = "Vcyt", nuc = "Vnuc"),   compartmentOf = c(A = "cyt", B = "nuc") ) print(f2) #> Conserved quantities: #>   total_1 = 1*Vcyt*A+1*Vnuc*B #>  #> Compartments: #>   cyt (V=Vcyt) #>   nuc (V=Vnuc) #> States by compartment: #>   cyt: A #>   nuc: B #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description #> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward #> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward print(as.eqnvec(f2)) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc/Vcyt) #>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt/Vnuc)-1*(k2*B)

title: Estimates of a mixed-effects fit — coef.em
code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/RtmpEh2W6Q/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/RtmpEh2W6Q/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## estimates and their standard errors coef(fit) #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>   0.4638825   3.4597479   1.0121568  -0.3647014  -0.4552240  -1.9774269  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  -1.3361153  sqrt(diag(vcov(fit))) #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>  0.19181010  0.04717589  0.08333122  0.07267625  0.23604232  0.29443384  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  0.25056516   ## marginal log-likelihood, AIC and BIC logLik(fit) #> 'log Lik.' -179.7016 (df=7) AIC(fit) #> [1] 373.4032 BIC(fit) #> [1] 393.5828  ## Wald intervals of all parameters, the profile interval of the clearance confint(fit) #>          name      value       lower        upper #> 1          Ka  0.4638825  0.08794164  0.839823427 #> 2           V  3.4597479  3.36728482  3.552210899 #> 3          Cl  1.0121568  0.84883060  1.175482991 #> 4   sigma_add -0.3647014 -0.50714422 -0.222258542 #> 5 omega_Ka_Ka -0.4552240 -0.91785850  0.007410402 #> 6   omega_V_V -1.9774269 -2.55450662 -1.400347157 #> 7 omega_Cl_Cl -1.3361153 -1.82721395 -0.845016587 confint(fit, parm = "Cl", method = "profile") #>   name    value     lower    upper #> 1   Cl 1.012157 0.8360508 1.191971 # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## profile intervals of all parameters confint(fit, method = "profile") } # }

title: Conserved Quantities of an Equation List — conservedQuantities
code: ## Equation list eq <- eqnlist() eq <- addReaction(eq, "A", "pA", "act_A * A * stimulus", "Phosphorylation of A") eq <- addReaction(eq, "pA", "A", "deact_A * pA", "Dephosphorylation of pA") eq <- addReaction(eq, "2*pA", "pA_pA", "form_complex_pA * pA^2", "Complex formation of pA") eq <- addReaction(eq, "B", "pB", "act_B * B * pA_pA", "Phosphorylation of B") eq <- addReaction(eq, "pB", "B", "deact_B * pB", "Dephosphorylation of pB")  ## Data frame of reactions reactions <- getReactions(eq) print(reactions) #>   Check Educt -> Product                   Rate             Description #> 1           A ->      pA   act_A * A * stimulus    Phosphorylation of A #> 2          pA ->       A           deact_A * pA Dephosphorylation of pA #> 3        2*pA ->   pA_pA form_complex_pA * pA^2 Complex formation of pA #> 4           B ->      pB      act_B * B * pA_pA    Phosphorylation of B #> 5          pB ->       B           deact_B * pB Dephosphorylation of pB  ## Conserved quantities print(conservedQuantities(eq)) #> $total_1 #> [1] "0.5*A+0.5*pA+1*pA_pA" #>  #> $total_2 #> [1] "1*B+1*pB" #>   ## Fluxes fluxes <- getFluxes(eq) print(fluxes) #> $A #>        Phosphorylation of A     Dephosphorylation of pA  #> "-1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"         "+1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>  #> $pA #>          Phosphorylation of A       Dephosphorylation of pA  #>    "1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"           "-1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>       Complex formation of pA  #> "-2*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $pA_pA #>      Complex formation of pA  #> "1*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $B #>     Phosphorylation of B  Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "-1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"      "+1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>  #> $pB #>    Phosphorylation of B Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"     "-1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>   ## Subsetting subeq1 <- subset(eq, "pB" %in% Product) print(subeq1) #> Conserved quantities: #>   pA_pA = 1*pA_pA #>   total_2 = 1*B+1*pB #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product              Rate          Description #> 1           B ->      pB act_B * B * pA_pA Phosphorylation of B subeq2 <- subset(eq, grepl("not_available", Description)) print(subeq2) #>  #> NULL  ## Equation vector of the ODE f <- as.eqnvec(eq) print(f) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(act_A*A*stimulus)+1*(deact_A*pA) #>   2     B <- -1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)+1*(deact_B*pB) #>   3    pA <- 1*(act_A*A*stimulus)-1*(deact_A*pA)-2*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   4 pA_pA <- 1*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   5    pB <- 1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)-1*(deact_B*pB)

code: ## Identity for four parameters, then log parameters trafo <- define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("A", "B", "k1", "k2")) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = .currentSymbols) trafo #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- exp(A) #>   2     B <- exp(B) #>   3    k1 <- exp(k1) #>   4    k2 <- exp(k2)  ## Replace k1 and k2 by expressions, fix B trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- y", x = c("k1", "k2"), y = c("q1 + q2", "q1 - q2")) trafo <- define(trafo, "B <- 0") trafo #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- exp(A) #>   2     B <- 0 #>   3    k1 <- exp(q1+q2) #>   4    k2 <- exp(q1-q2)  ## One branch per condition; the non-missing table entries are inserted conditions <- data.frame(dose = c(1, 10), q2 = c(NA, "q2_high"),                          row.names = c("low", "high")) trafoL <- branch(trafo, table = conditions, apply = "insert")  ## Condition-specific changes, selected by name or read off the table trafoL <- insert(trafoL, "x <- 2*x", x = "q1", conditionMatch = "^high") trafoL <- define(trafoL, "A <- dose", dose = dose) trafoL #> $low #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- 1 #>   2     B <- 0 #>   3    k1 <- exp(q1+q2) #>   4    k2 <- exp(q1-q2) #>  #> $high #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- 10 #>   2     B <- 0 #>   3    k1 <- exp((2*q1)+q2_high) #>   4    k2 <- exp((2*q1)-q2_high) #>  #> attr(,"tree") #>      dose      q2 #> low     1    <NA> #> high   10 q2_high

}  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # For an objective obj and a center of the starts: multistarts on two nodes # reached by ssh, one task per node with ten fits per core nodes <- sshNodes(c("server1", "server2"), cores = 16) jobFitting <- distributedComputing(   mstrust(obj, center, fits = 10 * cores, cores = cores, sd = 4),   on = nodes, jobname = "fits" ) jobFitting$wait() bestfit <- as.parvec(jobFitting$get()) jobFitting$purge(local = TRUE)  # Profiles of the best fit: one task per group of four parameters and side, on # the free cores of both nodes. get() joins the sides of every parameter. groups <- split(names(bestfit), ceiling(seq_along(bestfit) / 4)) jobProfiling <- distributedComputing(   profile(obj, bestfit, whichPar = groups[[task$group]], side = task$side,           limits = c(-5, 5), cores = cores),   tasks = expand.grid(group = seq_along(groups), side = c("left", "right"),                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE),   on = sshNodes(c("server1", "server2")), jobname = "profiles" ) jobProfiling$wait() profiles <- jobProfiling$get() confint(profiles)  # code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/RtmpEh2W6Q/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/RtmpEh2W6Q/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) init <- c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5))  ## FOCEI fit, the estimates and the random effects per subject fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init) fit #> EM (focei): -2 log L 359.403186, converged TRUE, 10 iterations, 12 groups #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>   0.4638825   3.4597479   1.0121568  -0.3647014  -0.4552240  -1.9774269  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  -1.3361153  #> Random effects: #>  type eta1 eta2  estimate         se #>    sd   Ka   Ka 0.6343058 0.14972302 #>    sd    V    V 0.1384250 0.04075699 #>    sd   Cl   Cl 0.2628648 0.06586477 summary(fit) #> EM summary (focei): -2 log L 359.403186, converged TRUE, 10 iterations #>   without the 2 pi constant of the data (NONMEM OBJ): 116.803413 #>  #> Parameters: #>             estimate      se rsePct #> Ka            0.4639 0.19180 41.350 #> V             3.4600 0.04718  1.364 #> Cl            1.0120 0.08333  8.233 #> sigma_add    -0.3647 0.07268 19.930 #> omega_Ka_Ka  -0.4552 0.23600 51.850 #> omega_V_V    -1.9770 0.29440 14.890 #> omega_Cl_Cl  -1.3360 0.25060 18.750 #> Standard errors without the curvature of the prediction in the random effects within the volume term (forward over reverse; derivMode = "forward-forward" gives the full one) #>  #> Random effects: #>  type eta1 eta2 estimate      se #>    sd   Ka   Ka   0.6343 0.14970 #>    sd    V    V   0.1384 0.04076 #>    sd   Cl   Cl   0.2629 0.06586 #>  #> Shrinkage: eta_Ka = 0.018, eta_V = 0.103, eta_Cl = 0.039  fit$omega #>   type eta1 eta2  estimate         se #> 1   sd   Ka   Ka 0.6343058 0.14972302 #> 2   sd    V    V 0.1384250 0.04075699 #> 3   sd   Cl   Cl 0.2628648 0.06586477 head(fit$random) #>   group eta parameter        mode        se #> 1     1  Ka  eta_Ka_1  0.08621976 0.1515854 #> 2     2  Ka  eta_Ka_2  0.19818408 0.1725709 #> 3     3  Ka  eta_Ka_3  0.37186008 0.1810720 #> 4     4  Ka  eta_Ka_4 -0.28173371 0.1640986 #> 5     5  Ka  eta_Ka_5 -0.04271272 0.1461175 #> 6     6  Ka  eta_Ka_6 -0.38568935 0.2043190  ## quadrature started from the FOCEI estimates, and SAEM fitQ <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = fit, method = "quadrature", verbose = FALSE) fitS <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = init, method = "saem", verbose = FALSE) c(focei = fit$value, quadrature = fitQ$value, saem = fitS$value) #>      focei quadrature       saem  #>   359.4032   360.7089   360.7757  # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## Ka and Cl with correlated random effects, V with a spike-and-slab one: a second transformation p2 <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | p | ID), V ~ 1 + (1 | gr(ID, dist = spikeSlab()))),         method = "explicit", compile = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_p2", derivMode = dm,         outdir = tempdir()) compile(p2, output = tempfile("theoph")) fit2 <- em(normL2(data, g * x * p2, errmodel = err), randomEffects(p2), init = init) fit2$omega fit2$slab AIC(fit, fit2) } # }

Convert to data.frame fdata <- as.data.frame(f) print(fdata) #>   Description Rate  A  B #> 1     forward k1*A -1  1 #> 2    backward k2*B  1 -1  # Flat `volumes`: each distinct expression becomes a compartment c1, c2, ... f <- as.eqnlist(fdata, volumes = c(A = "Vcyt", B = "Vnuc")) print(f) #> Conserved quantities: #>   total_1 = 1*Vcyt*A+1*Vnuc*B #>  #> Compartments: #>   c1 (V=Vcyt) #>   c2 (V=Vnuc) #> States by compartment: #>   c1: A #>   c2: B #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description #> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward #> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward print(as.eqnvec(f)) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc/Vcyt) #>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt/Vnuc)-1*(k2*B) print(as.eqnvec(f, type = "amount")) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc) #>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt)-1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc)  # Data frame of reactions reactions <- getReactions(eq) print(reactions) #>   Check Educt -> Product                   Rate             Description #> 1           A ->      pA   act_A * A * stimulus    Phosphorylation of A #> 2          pA ->       A           deact_A * pA Dephosphorylation of pA #> 3        2*pA ->   pA_pA form_complex_pA * pA^2 Complex formation of pA #> 4           B ->      pB      act_B * B * pA_pA    Phosphorylation of B #> 5          pB ->       B           deact_B * pB Dephosphorylation of pB  ## Conserved quantities print(conservedQuantities(eq)) #> $total_1 #> [1] "0.5*A+0.5*pA+1*pA_pA" #>  #> $total_2 #> [1] "1*B+1*pB" #>   ## Fluxes fluxes <- getFluxes(eq) print(fluxes) #> $A #>        Phosphorylation of A     Dephosphorylation of pA  #> "-1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"         "+1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>  #> $pA #>          Phosphorylation of A       Dephosphorylation of pA  #>    "1*(act_A * A * stimulus)"           "-1*(deact_A * pA)"  #>       Complex formation of pA  #> "-2*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $pA_pA #>      Complex formation of pA  #> "1*(form_complex_pA * pA^2)"  #>  #> $B #>     Phosphorylation of B  Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "-1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"      "+1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>  #> $pB #>    Phosphorylation of B Dephosphorylation of pB  #> "1*(act_B * B * pA_pA)"     "-1*(deact_B * pB)"  #>   ## Subsetting subeq1 <- subset(eq, "pB" %in% Product) print(subeq1) #> Conserved quantities: #>   pA_pA = 1*pA_pA #>   total_2 = 1*B+1*pB #>  #>   Check Educt -> Product              Rate          Description #> 1           B ->      pB act_B * B * pA_pA Phosphorylation of B subeq2 <- subset(eq, grepl("not_available", Description)) print(subeq2) #>  #> NULL  ## Equation vector of the ODE f <- as.eqnvec(eq) print(f) #> Idx Inner <- Outer #>   1     A <- -1*(act_A*A*stimulus)+1*(deact_A*pA) #>   2     B <- -1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)+1*(deact_B*pB) #>   3    pA <- 1*(act_A*A*stimulus)-1*(deact_A*pA)-2*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   4 pA_pA <- 1*(form_complex_pA*pA^2) #>   5    pB <- 1*(act_B*B*pA_pA)-1*(deact_B*pB)

title: Import a PEtab Problem — importPEtab
text: yamlPath Path PEtab YAML manifest. backend Required, one "deSolve", "cppDE" "Sundials", passed odemodel(). compile Logical. TRUE (default), generated sources compiled. FALSE leaves uncompiled inspection. cores Number parallel compilation jobs, passed compile(). Default 1. modelname Base name generated files. Default NULL, base name YAML file. derivMode Derivative directions build, passed odemodel(), Y() P(): "forward" (default), "reverse", c("forward", "reverse") "none". "reverse" "none" need backend = "cppDE" "Sundials"; "none" objective called deriv = FALSE. First order . options, optionsSens Lists passed Xs(): solver options every solve overrides solves sensitivities. Default NULL, backend's defaults. sparse NULL (default) lets cppDE Sundials backend choose sparse (KLU) dense linear solver; TRUE FALSE sets . stability TRUE (default), problem preequilibration gets constraintStability() term per steady state obj, zero stable one away stability boundary; steady states built second derivatives. FALSE leaves term . outdir Directory generated sources shared objects, one source per condition. Default getOption("dMod2.outdir"), else working directory.

title: Import a PEtab Problem — importPEtab
text: list class "petabproblem" components dataList, reactions, odemodel, g, x, p, e, prd (composite g * x * p), obj, stability, bestfit, parlower parupper. stability constraintStability() term obj, NULL. several models, reactions, odemodel, g, x p lists model id. obj PEtab fixed parameters set; bestfit PEtab nominalValue estimated parameter PEtab parameterScale, scales attribute "petab_scales", parlower parupper bounds scale. attribute "petab_meta" list holds exportPEtabObject() needs, among fixed parameters fixed, linear scale.

title: Import a PEtab Problem — importPEtab
text: Supported: one problem per YAML file number v2 model files; preequilibration; number periods per v2 experiment, first applied events, one schedule experiments start condition; observable transformations lin, log log10; noise distribution normal, log-normal v2; v2 mapping table. Priors distributions uniform, normal, log-normal, cauchy, chisquare, exponential, gamma, laplace, log-laplace, log-uniform rayleigh, also parameterScale prefix, added obj, truncated parameter bounds. prior without prefix linear parameter: parameter log log10 scale density back-transformed value, without Jacobian term. supported: model languages SBML noise distributions.

code: # \donttest{ ## Theophylline, 12 subjects: one-compartment model with first-order absorption in closed ## form, log parameters with a normal random intercept per subject, additive error th <- datasets::Theoph th$Subject <- as.character(th$Subject) subjects <- unique(th$Subject) data <- as.datalist(data.frame(name = "y", time = th$Time, value = th$conc, sigma = NA_real_,                                condition = th$Subject)) ## second derivatives forward over reverse, the default of em() dm <- c("forward", "reverse", "forward-reverse") x <- Xt() g <- Y(c(y = "amt * Ka / (V * Ka - Cl) * (exp(-Cl / V * time) - exp(-Ka * time))"),        states = "time", modelname = "theoph_obs", compile = FALSE, derivMode = dm,        outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/RtmpEh2W6Q/theoph_obs.cpp err <- Y(c(y = "sigma_add"), g, attachInput = FALSE, modelname = "theoph_err", compile = FALSE,          derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) #> Overwriting: /tmp/RtmpEh2W6Q/theoph_err.cpp ## one condition per subject with the subject dose; the effect formula replaces each log parameter ## by an intercept plus a random effect per subject doses <- tapply(th$Dose * th$Wt, th$Subject, `[`, 1)[subjects] trafo <- branch(define(NULL, "x <- x", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "amt", "sigma_add")),                 table = data.frame(ID = subjects, dose = doses, row.names = subjects)) trafo <- insert(trafo, "amt <- dose", dose = dose) trafo <- insert(trafo, "x <- exp(x)", x = c("Ka", "V", "Cl", "sigma_add")) p <- P(insert(trafo, Ka + V + Cl ~ 1 + (1 | ID)), method = "explicit", compile = FALSE,        modelname = "theoph_p", derivMode = dm, outdir = tempdir()) compile(g, err, p, output = tempfile("theoph")) #> using C++ compiler: g++ [-O2 -DNDEBUG -w -fPIC] #> reusing 14 unchanged object(s) obj <- normL2(data, g * x * p, errmodel = err) fit <- em(obj, randomEffects(p), init = c(Ka = 0, V = 3, Cl = 0.7, sigma_add = log(0.5)))  ## estimates and their standard errors coef(fit) #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>   0.4638825   3.4597479   1.0121568  -0.3647014  -0.4552240  -1.9774269  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  -1.3361153  sqrt(diag(vcov(fit))) #>          Ka           V          Cl   sigma_add omega_Ka_Ka   omega_V_V  #>  0.19181010  0.04717589  0.08333122  0.07267625  0.23604232  0.29443384  #> omega_Cl_Cl  #>  0.25056516   ## marginal log-likelihood, AIC and BIC logLik(fit) #> 'log Lik.' -179.7016 (df=7) AIC(fit) #> [1] 373.4032 BIC(fit) #> [1] 393.5828  ## Wald intervals of all parameters, the profile interval of the clearance confint(fit) #>          name      value       lower        upper #> 1          Ka  0.4638825  0.08794164  0.839823427 #> 2           V  3.4597479  3.36728482  3.552210899 #> 3          Cl  1.0121568  0.84883060  1.175482991 #> 4   sigma_add -0.3647014 -0.50714422 -0.222258542 #> 5 omega_Ka_Ka -0.4552240 -0.91785850  0.007410402 #> 6   omega_V_V -1.9774269 -2.55450662 -1.400347157 #> 7 omega_Cl_Cl -1.3361153 -1.82721395 -0.845016587 confint(fit, parm = "Cl", method = "profile") #>   name    value     lower    upper #> 1   Cl 1.012157 0.8360508 1.191971 # } if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ ## profile intervals of all parameters confint(fit, method = "profile") } # }
